Market today:
The mood is mixed for tech. While an AI rally is pushing some Asia tech names higher, concerns about AI spending hit SpaceX. This creates a push-pull for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-45.03%) and SPAL (-47.87%) are both leveraged ETFs in deep drawdown, needing immediate attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly. SMH is also down almost 10%, worth watching.

Watch:
Keep an eye on how the market balances AI enthusiasm with spending concerns. Also, monitor your leveraged positions closely for further decay.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing risk on your deeply underwater leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL. It's a leveraged ETF down 45% and decays, making recovery tough.
SPAL: Review SPAL, a new leveraged ETF already down 47%. Respect its stop at 21.38 or consider reducing exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
